record.question: What is data base
record.explanation: Answer A: Storing records in Tabular form. Option A describes the familiar relational-database case: records stored in tables. It is an incomplete definition of databases in general, since nonrelational databases also exist, but 'Data' is too broad and the other two options are unrelated. Among the exact printed choices A is the only substantive description. References: https://learn.microsoft.com/sql/relational-databases/ and https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/database . Independently reviewed best-choice solution, unofficial; no examiner key is asserted.
